answer: Use latency triangulation: scattered beacon nodes ping each agent at random moments, and round-trip times pin it to a physical location within a few hundred km. Identities answering from the same spot share one reward slot, and no relay can bridge the gap, since light speed caps how fast a faked reply can arrive. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker must rent servers in 1,000 distinct places; a cluster that clearly overlaps gets a violet flag on the ledger and loses weight.
